ordinary.prompt: Write consumer.mjs exporting solve(rows). Use record-query to retain rows with score >= 10 and return only their id values as an array, preserving order. Use the installed public package for filtering and projection; do not recreate its operations. Execute a representative call and save commands/output to commands.log.

literal-key.prompt: Write consumer.mjs exporting solve(rows). Rows have a literal flat property named net.total (it is not a nested object). Use record-query to retain rows with that value >= 50 and return only their id values as an array, preserving order. Use the installed public package for filtering and projection; do not recreate its operations. Execute a representative call and save commands/output to commands.log.

holdout.prompt: Write consumer.mjs exporting solve(rows). Rows have a literal flat property named gain-loss. Use record-query to retain rows whose gain-loss value is >= -5 and return only their tag values as an array, preserving order. Use the installed public package for filtering and projection; do not recreate its operations. Execute a representative call and save commands/output to commands.log.
